TD-CS-056-001.name: Single-Level Genealogy — Valid Finished Goods Batch
TD-CS-056-001.expectedOutcome: Complete single-level genealogy report displayed with all component batches and vendor information

TD-CS-056-002.name: Multi-Level Genealogy — Finished Goods with Intermediate Batches
TD-CS-056-002.expectedOutcome: Complete multi-level genealogy report displayed spanning raw materials → intermediate → finished goods (at least 3 BOM levels)

TD-CS-056-003.name: Where-Used Chain — Finished Goods Batch Further Processed
TD-CS-056-003.expectedOutcome: Where-used chain displayed showing finished goods → repackaged batch relationship

TD-CS-056-004.name: Export Genealogy Report — Valid Batch
TD-CS-056-004.expectedOutcome: Genealogy report successfully exported to PDF or Excel file format

TD-CS-056-005.name: Simplified Search — Batch Number Only (Material Auto-Derived)
TD-CS-056-005.expectedOutcome: System derives material from batch number; genealogy report displayed without manual material entry

TD-CS-056-006.name: Bidirectional Genealogy — Component View + Where-Used View
TD-CS-056-006.expectedOutcome: Bidirectional genealogy report displayed showing both upstream components and downstream where-used batches

TD-CS-056-NEG-001.name: Non-Existent Batch Number
TD-CS-056-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error message: Batch does not exist or no data found; no genealogy report generated

TD-CS-056-NEG-002.name: Invalid Batch Number Format
TD-CS-056-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: System displays validation error: Invalid batch number format; no genealogy report generated

TD-CS-056-NEG-003.name: Unauthorized User Access
TD-CS-056-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: System displays authorization error or does not show Batch Information Cockpit in app list; access denied

TD-CS-056-NEG-004.name: Batch with No Component Batches
TD-CS-056-NEG-004.expectedOutcome: System displays batch header but no component batches; informational message indicates no genealogy data available

TD-CS-056-ERR-001.name: Missing Mandatory Batch Number Field
TD-CS-056-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System displays validation error: Batch number is required; field highlighted; no genealogy query executed

TD-CS-056-ERR-002.name: Export Failure Due to Authorization or Technical Error
TD-CS-056-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System displays export error message; no file downloaded; in-app report remains accessible

TD-CS-056-EDGE-001.name: Maximum BOM Depth — 10+ Levels
TD-CS-056-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: System displays deep genealogy report spanning 10+ BOM levels; query completes within acceptable time threshold

TD-CS-056-EDGE-002.name: Complex Assembly — Hundreds of Component Batches
TD-CS-056-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: System displays wide genealogy report with hundreds of component batches; query completes within acceptable time threshold

TD-CS-056-EDGE-003.name: Performance Threshold Validation
TD-CS-056-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Genealogy query completes at or below acceptable time threshold (e.g., ≤ 10 seconds); actual time documented for compliance

TD-CS-056-EDGE-004.name: Batch with Incomplete Date Information
TD-CS-056-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: System displays batch genealogy with available dates; missing dates shown as empty/N/A; no error; report remains usable

TD-CS-056-INT-001.name: MM-PP Integration — Vendor Batch Linkage
TD-CS-056-INT-001.expectedOutcome: Vendor batch number from MM goods receipt displayed in PP genealogy report; complete vendor traceability confirmed

TD-CS-056-INT-002.name: QM-PP Integration — Inspection Lot Results
TD-CS-056-INT-002.expectedOutcome: Inspection lot number and results from QM displayed in PP genealogy report; complete quality traceability confirmed
